attributes.residual: ONE NAMED MECHANISM, and it is a TOOLING defect, not a codegen residual. verify_consistent_recolor fails at +0x2c with 'use of g5 does not correspond to g5 under the running renaming' - an offset 0x330 bytes BEFORE the first differing word, which is the tell. Root cause, proven: webfrank._jumptable_targets collects every ADDR32 data relocation whose symbol lies in .text and whose value+addend lands inside the function; for CritterDoTexmodNode that set is {0x0, 0x20c, 0x24c, 0x254, 0x25c, 0x264, 0x26c}. The five 0x2xx entries are the genuine case labels of jumptable_8011AF20 (dispatched by the bctr at +0x208); the 0x0 entry is NOT a case label - it is a function-pointer reference to CritterDoTexmodNode itself resolving to fn_start. Including it gives the CFG a spurious back-edge from the bctr to the FUNCTION ENTRY, so the prologue block is re-entered with a map already narrowed by the switch arms' call-clobbers, and the identity assumptions the prologue needs are destroyed. PROOF (read-only experiment, build/scratch/dbg4.py): with the target set as shipped the bisimulation FAILS; with the single entry offset 0x0 excluded and nothing else changed it PASSES cleanly over all 463 instructions with NO unproven_recolor_audit escape. A computed branch to a function's own entry would re-execute stwu/stmw and cannot be a compiler-generated switch case, so excluding fn_start from the computed-branch target set is a correctness fix, not a relaxation of the semantic guard. DELIBERATELY NOT SHIPPED two ways: (a) no unproven_recolor_audit escape was used - the residual is provable, and using the audit hatch to paper over a fixable tooling defect is exactly the guard-weakening the tool contract forbids; (b) tools/gdl/webfrank.py was NOT edited, because it is shared machinery every concurrent fleet derives rules against and a CFG change there would race them. INTEGRATOR ACTION: make the one-line fix in _jumptable_targets (drop the fn_start entry), add a test, then ship the derived rule - before_sha256 and after_sha256 are reproducible in one command via build/scratch/wfharness.py derive game/enemy/critter CritterDoTexmodNode.
